hints.title: Boundary Projection Search
hints.text: Project rows and columns into boolean flags to discover the extreme minimum and maximum coordinates of the enclosing box.

hints.title: Monotonic Interval Boundaries
hints.text: Because black pixels form a single connected component, row and column projections exhibit monotonic transitions.

hints.title: Four-Way Coordinate Search
hints.text: Binary search top row in [0, x], bottom row in [x + 1, m], left col in [0, y], and right col in [y + 1, n]. Check whether a mid row or col contains any 1. Area is (right - left) * (bottom - top).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.time: O(M log N + N log M)
complexity.notes: Optimal logarithmic boundary searching via connected component projection.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning every pixel takes linear O(M * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on 4 boundaries reduces checks to logarithmic row/column scans.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use connected component property to ensure projected row and column presence is contiguous.
